items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I went to Oklahoma with Battle and got with Gene Coy's Black Aces too.

ctx.x: What about the cousins. They had left home.

Allen went with Gene Coy's Black Aces -- wait a minute, Clyde went with Gene Coy's Black Aces and then Allen went, you know, Oklahoma City and Battles went. Then when the Mamie Smith show closed, I went to Oklahoma with Battle and got with Gene Coy's Black Aces too.
